description: Check the plan and credits left (plan credits this month, free trial, purchased) before planning paid runs, or after a 402 refusal. Also says whether Core is billed monthly or annually and when it renews or ends (subscription), and whether the free trial has ended and needs a card (offer.payment_needed). A Developer workspace with a saved card is billed monthly for what it uses (extra_credits.billed_after_use). Changing, cancelling or resuming the plan is done by a person on the billing page (billing_url); share that link rather than trying it yourself. Read-only; never returns payment details.
name: get_billing
title: Get plan and credit balance
